column1: # Third-party notices that RISE binary distributions must carry.
# One line per file: <package> TAB <repo-relative path> TAB <distributions>.
# <distributions> is a comma-separated subset of macos, android, windows,
# blender, or "all".  Every packager reads this file and fails if a listed
# Notices for libraries that come from OUTSIDE the repository (Homebrew,
# vcpkg, the OIDN / OpenPGL installs, the Android NDK) are found by each
# packager at packaging time; see licenses/README.md.
# Adding ported or vendored code to the library: add its notice here.
# tools/test_third_party_notices.py checks that every extlib/ directory a
# build compiles has an entry for that build.
